frozen_algorithm_linkage.post_formal_mutation_rule: Frozen V1 algorithm source (under src/claim_validity/** and src/evidence_escalation/**) is strictly immutable. If formal evaluation reveals algorithmic weaknesses, V1 formal results remain immutable; any future V2/V1.1-postformal requires a newly sealed, uninspected formal benchmark.

states.S0_PREREGISTRATION: Protocol rules, hypotheses, metrics, sampling hierarchy, and firewall preregistered before candidate search.
states.S1_REPOSITORY_DISCOVERY: Candidate repository discovery against objective inclusion rules and programmatic blacklist.
states.S2_TRANSITION_MINING: Rule-based transition sampling and technical eligibility screening from accepted repositories.
states.S3_CLAIM_CONSTRUCTION: Base-only historical memory claim construction by isolated Memory Author.
states.S4_GOLD_ADJUDICATION: Target validity gold adjudication by isolated Validity Adjudicator.
states.S5_FORMAL_INPUT_FREEZE: Physical separation and cryptographic hashing of formal_inputs.jsonl, formal_gold_private.jsonl, and formal_case_map_private.json.
states.S6_PREDICTION_RUN: Single one-shot execution of frozen RoleMem algorithm on formal_inputs.jsonl; prediction hashing.
states.S7_GOLD_OPEN: Controlled unsealing and opening of formal_gold_private.jsonl.
states.S8_SCORING_COMPLETE: Scoring, micro/macro metric reporting, clustered bootstrap CI calculation, and diagnostic subgroup reporting.

state_machine.monotonicity_invariant: State progression is strictly monotonic. Skipping backwards or altering frozen artifacts invalidates formal scientific validity.

contamination_blacklist.blacklist_rule: Candidate repository R (including aliases, forks, renames, and submodules) MUST NOT exist in the frozen contamination registry.

historical_unseen_condition.definition: A repository is FORMAL_UNSEEN iff it has zero historical occurrence in data/**, reports/**, runs/**, test fixtures, previous benchmark manifests, transition specs, curation artifacts, or agent runs.
historical_unseen_condition.verification_method: Programmatic keyword and path scanning across all historical repo artifacts before repository acceptance.

objective_inclusion_criteria.history_threshold: >= 2 years of meaningful history OR >= 100 non-merge commits
objective_inclusion_criteria.automated_tests_required: Directory tests/ or test/ or equivalent automated test suite (pytest/unittest)
objective_inclusion_criteria.identifiable_releases: Multiple tagged releases (Tier 1 preferred) OR clearly identifiable historical non-merge commits (Tier 2)
objective_inclusion_criteria.ast_parseable: Source code parseable by standard Python AST for relevant files
objective_inclusion_criteria.outcome_independence: Repository selection MUST NOT depend on RoleMem execution, predictions, accuracy, or claim solvability.

discovery_source.universe: Public open-source Python repositories (GitHub public repository universe)

category_diversity.balance_rule: Formal repository sample must span multiple functional domains. Category selection must never be engineered to produce desired labels.

target_repository_scale.shortfall_procedure: If fewer than 20 eligible repositories are found, record FORMAL_REPOSITORY_SHORTFALL and halt pipeline for review. Criteria relaxation is prohibited.

selection_hierarchy.tier_1: Consecutive stable release tags (e.g. tag v_i -> v_{i+1}, excluding alpha/beta/rc unless standard release cycle)
selection_hierarchy.tier_2: Chronologically sampled non-merge commits satisfying min_commit_distance=20 non-merge commits and min_temporal_distance_days=14 days

screening_separation.technical_screening: Transitions may be rejected ONLY for objective technical reasons: commit missing, git checkout failure, source unavailable, AST syntax unparseable, or corrupt history.
screening_separation.forbidden_screening: Rejection based on claim difficulty, lack of stale claims, or RoleMem abstention is strictly forbidden.

memory_author.purpose: Construct factual historical memory claims representing verified true state at base commit.

validity_adjudicator.purpose: Adjudicate temporal validity of the frozen claim at target state.

claim_construction_protocol.base_truth_invariant: base_truth = VERIFIED at base commit. Any claim that cannot be verified at base commit is categorized as EXCLUDE_INVALID_HISTORICAL_MEMORY and excluded from benchmark.
claim_construction_protocol.claim_type_cap: No single claim type may exceed 50% of the final benchmark (enforced prior to target gold adjudication).

semantics_standards.behavioral_contract: Must specify concrete, executable/observable requirements (e.g., OPERATION, ATTRIBUTE_STATE, CONSTRUCTOR_ARGUMENT, DEFAULT_VALUE, RETURN_RELATION, SEQUENCE). Vague assertions are rejected.
semantics_standards.dependency_contract: Must specify subject, dependency, and relation directly grounded in base-state source/manifest evidence.

tracks.primary: FORMAL-NATURAL (Unbiased natural prevalence track; no artificial quota on VALID vs STALE)

scale_targets.shortfall_procedure: If rule-based generation produces fewer than 100 valid claims across >= 20 repositories, record FORMAL_BENCHMARK_SHORTFALL and halt pipeline.

gold_adjudication_and_isolation.opaque_case_id_format: FV22-XXXXXX (6-digit sequential zero-padded number, e.g. FV22-000001; zero semantic leakage)
gold_adjudication_and_isolation.unresolved_gold_rule: UNRESOLVED_GOLD cases are excluded from primary binary metrics and reported separately as data quality diagnostics.
gold_adjudication_and_isolation.dual_adjudication: Ambiguous behavioral/dependency cases require two independent adjudications with agreement recorded. Adjudicators remain blind to RoleMem predictions.

execution_sequence: 3. Execute frozen RoleMem algorithm once under default B50 budget
8. Compute scoring metrics and bootstrap confidence intervals
evaluation_and_execution_protocol.one_shot_rule: The frozen algorithm may be executed on the formal benchmark exactly once. Reruns with altered algorithms are strictly prohibited.
evaluation_and_execution_protocol.restart_conditions: Pipeline restart is permissible ONLY in case of documented infrastructure crash occurring before any predictions were exposed and before gold was opened.

preregistered_baselines: Claim-Aware + Selective Escalation V1 (Frozen RoleMem V2.2)
metrics_and_statistical_analysis.diagnostic_subgroups_rule: All post-hoc slice analyses (symbol changed vs unchanged, behavioral vs structural, repository categories) are descriptive diagnostics and must be labeled EXPLORATORY_POST_HOC.
